Stuck on the toilet with GLP-1? You're not alone! 

Introducing Motilli — a celery juice gummy with apigenin, chlorophyllin, and prebiotic fiber that works where the problem actually starts: your stomach. No harsh laxatives. No cramping. Just take 2 gummies with dinner and get moving again.
creative.title: Finally. Gentle Relief for GLP-1 Users.
